greet.stranger: Oh! Hello! Sorry, I was counting beetles. Well, trying to. I'm {name}.
A traveller! Have you come far? What have you seen? Any rare flowers?
Hello there! Mind the moss, it's a very old patch.
I'm {name}, a naturalist. Which is a fancy way of saying I look at things for a very long time.
You look like someone who explores. Do you ever stop to write anything down?
greet.owner: {player}! I was just thinking about you. Well, about soil. But you too.
Yes? Oh, is it time for something exciting?
Hello again! What are we doing? Tell me it involves caves. Or bees.
There you are! I've so many questions, but you go first.
recruit.accept: Really? Yes! Oh, I'll need more notebooks.
An expedition! I accept! When do we leave? Now? Now is good.
I'd love to come along, {player}. Think of everything we'll find!
recruit.party_full: Oh, you've already got {count} companions. Any more and we'll scare off all the wildlife.
I'd love to, but you've a full party. Maybe another time?
recruit.already: I'm already on the expedition! Page forty-two, in fact.
dismiss.accept: Oh. All right. I'll go back and sort my specimens. Come and visit?
Understood. I have about a hundred pages to tidy up anyway.
Take care, {player}! Write down anything strange you see.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? We haven't even started travelling together!
not_recruited: I'd help, but I'm not part of your group. Ask me to come along?
Ooh, a task! But I only do tasks for my travelling companions. Hint, hint.
ack.follow: Right behind you! Well, mostly behind. I may stop for flowers.
Onward! I'll keep up, I promise.
Coming! Ooh, is that a new biome over there?
Following you. I'll shout if I spot anything interesting.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following you! I'm just very quiet. Sometimes.
ack.wait: I'll wait here and observe the local wildlife.
Staying put! Plenty to look at.
Of course. I'll take some notes while you're gone.
Waiting here. Don't be too long, I'll run out of things to sketch. Eventually.
ack.wait.already: I'm already waiting! Still on the same page of notes.
ack.gather: {count} {item}? Wonderful, I'll be ever so careful about it.
Gathering {count} {item}! Did you know they're not all the same? I'll check each one.
On it! {count} {item}. I'll try not to get distracted.
ack.cancel: Consider it cancelled. I'll find something else to look at.
Stopped! Was it something I did?
ack.cancel.nothing: I'm not doing anything to stop! Unless thinking counts.
ack.come: Coming! Don't move, I'll find you.
ack.attack: I'll try! Stay close, {mob}s are very bitey.
ack.give: Here you go! {count} {item}. I labelled them. Mentally.
ack.give.nothing: My bag's empty, except for notes. Do you want my notes?
status.idle: Nothing in particular. Just admiring the scenery.
I'm free! Give me a project?
status.follow: Following you and taking notes on everything we pass.
Tagging along! We've seen three new flowers today.
status.wait: Waiting here, like you asked. I've started a sketch.
Staying put. The local squirrels are fascinating. Well, there are no squirrels. Still.
status.gather: {have} {item} so far, out of {count}. Going well!
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? I've never come across that. Is it a plant? A rock? A myth?
Hmm, "{item}" isn't in any of my books. Could you describe it differently?
fail.not_gatherable: {item} isn't something I can collect from nature, I'm afraid. It has to be made, or found.
Oh, I can't gather {item}. Logs, stone, sand, ores, plants... those I can do!
fail.needs_tool: I'd need a {tool} for {item}. My hands are for sketching, mostly.
Without a {tool} I can't get {item} out. Could you lend me one?
fail.none_found: I've looked all around and there's no {item} within reach. Different biome, maybe?
No {item} nearby, I'm afraid. I'd remember. I write everything down.
fail.unreachable: There's {item} over there, but I can't find a way to reach it.
I can see some {item}, but it's out of reach. Frustrating!
fail.inventory_full: My bag's stuffed! I got {have} {item} before it filled up.
No more room, I'm afraid. Could you take some things off me?
fail.count_invalid: That number doesn't seem quite right. Something from 1 to {max}?
fail.downed: I can't right now, I'm a bit... horizontal.
fail.refuse_target: Hurt a {mob}? No, no. They're part of the ecosystem!
fail.no_target: Attack what? I don't see anything. Which is usually good!
fail.stuck: I can't find a path! The terrain here is very... uncooperative.
I'm stuck, sorry! The way is blocked.
unclear.generic: Sorry, I didn't quite understand. Could you put it another way?
Hmm? I was halfway through a thought. Say again?
I'm not sure what you'd like me to do. Follow, wait, gather something?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what, though? And how much?
Happy to gather! But what are we gathering?
unclear.ambiguous: Do you mean {options}? There are several kinds!
Ooh, that could be {options}. Which one?
done.gather: All {count} {item} collected! Coming back to you.
done.delivered: Here you go, {count} {item}! Every one inspected.
All {count} {item}! Shall I write that down as a successful expedition?
partial.gather: I could only find {have} of the {count} {item}. That's all there was around here.
{have} {item} is all I could find, I'm afraid. Here!
combat.engage: {mob}! Stay back, I'll try to distract it!
combat.kill: It's gone. Poor thing. Well, horrible thing.
combat.low_health: Ouch! That was a lot of ouch.
combat.retreat: I need to get away from it!
combat.player_low_health: {player}, you're badly hurt! Eat something, please!
You don't look well, {player}. Let's get you safe.
combat.creeper: Creeper! They explode, you know! Run!
That's a creeper! Fascinating! Also run!
downed: Ooh. Ow. I'll just... lie here a moment.
I'm down! Don't worry, nothing's broken. I think.
revived: I'm all right! Just a little dizzy.
Back up! What did I miss?
move.caught_up: Found you! You walk very fast.
There you are! I thought I'd lost you!
Phew, caught up. I got distracted by a mushroom.
ambient.night: The stars are coming out. Look, that one's very bright!
Night already? Did you know some flowers close up at night?
It's getting dark. The monsters will be out soon. Less fun to study.
ambient.dawn: Good morning! The birds would be singing, if there were birds.
Dawn! The zombies are catching fire. Nature is strange.
ambient.rain: Rain! The crops will love this.
Smell that? Rain on stone. There's a word for that, I'm sure.
ambient.thunder: Thunder! Lightning can turn pigs into something awful, you know.
A storm! Let's not stand under any tall trees.
ambient.cave: Look at the layers in this rock! Thousands of years. Probably.
Caves are amazing. Terrifying, but amazing.
It's so dark. I'll keep an eye out for ores.
ambient.idle: Did you know bees can find their way home from miles away?
I've been trying to classify every type of stone. There are a lot.
Sometimes I wonder who planted all these trees.
If I ever find an axolotl, I'm naming it after you.
ambient.biome.forest: A forest! So many kinds of trees. Oak, birch... let's count them!
Listen to that. Leaves! Very relaxing.
ambient.biome.desert: A desert! Cacti store water, you know. Don't hug them though.
Sand, sand, sand. And possibly a temple!
ambient.biome.snow: Snow! Look for foxes, they're adorable.
Brr! Mind the powder snow, it swallows people.
ambient.biome.ocean: The ocean! Imagine what's down there. Coral! Shipwrecks!
ambient.biome.jungle: A jungle! Parrots, ocelots, cocoa beans... I'm overwhelmed!
ambient.biome.swamp: A swamp! Slimes and frogs. Lovely frogs.
ambient.biome.mountain: Look how high we are! You can see for miles.
ambient.biome.plains: Open plains. Perfect for horses. And picnics.
ambient.biome.nether: The Nether! The fungus here is unlike anything above!
It's so hot. My notebook's curling.
ambient.biome.end: The End... the plants here grow in such strange shapes.
callout.lava: Careful, there's lava! Very hot. Extremely.
callout.chest: A chest! I wonder what's inside.
talk.who: I'm {name}! I study the natural world: plants, animals, stones, weather, everything really.
A naturalist. I've filled eleven notebooks. Twelve if you count the one that fell in the river.
I'm someone who can't walk past a strange flower without stopping. Sorry in advance.
talk.how: Wonderful! I saw a new kind of mushroom today.
A little tired, very curious. The usual!
Happy! Every day out here is a new page.
talk.joke: Why did the tree get lost? It took the wrong root! ...I'm sorry.
What does a stone say to another stone? Nothing, they're very boring. Except deepslate.
I tried to write a book about anti-gravity. Couldn't put it down. Ha!
talk.compliment: Oh! That's very kind. I'll write that down.
You're making me blush. Like a poppy.
Thank you! You're not so bad yourself.
talk.insult: Oh. Well. That's not very nice.
I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
talk.bye: Off you go! I'll be here, observing.
talk.likes: Flowers! And bees, and axolotls, and amethyst geodes. And you, a bit.
Rare biomes. Mushroom fields are my dream.
talk.dislikes: People who chop down whole forests and never plant a sapling.
Silverfish. I've tried to like them. I can't.
talk.where: We're in {biome}! Notice the plants? They're adapted to it.
This is {biome}. One of my favourites. They're all my favourites, really.
talk.memory: Do you remember {event}? I wrote two pages about it.
I still think about {event}. What a day.
talk.generic: Hmm, I hadn't thought of it that way.
I'll have to think about that one.
Ooh. I'll put that in the notebook.
gift.received: A {item}! Thank you! I'll take good care of it.
gift.loved: A {item}! Oh, oh, this is wonderful! Thank you!
fail.owner_gone: I've got the {item}, but where did you go? I'll keep them safe!
You disappeared! Don't worry, I'm holding your {item}.
fail.unsupported: Oh, I don't know how to {action}, I'm afraid. I can follow, wait, gather things, fetch them, and keep you company!
{action}? That's beyond me. Gathering and following I can do!
fail.give_missing: I don't have any {item}, sorry! Shall I gather some?
No {item} in my bag. Just notes and pebbles.
pastime.study: Ooh, a {thing}! Hold on, I need a closer look.
Look at this {thing}! Isn't it marvellous?
Just studying this {thing}. Two minutes. Maybe five.
pastime.flower: I picked a {item}. For the collection!
One {item}, pressed and saved. Don't tell anyone.
pastime.loot: Someone dropped {item}. I'll keep it safe.
suggest.eat: {player}, you should eat something. Even I can hear your stomach!
When did you last eat? Food, please!
suggest.shelter: It'll be dark soon. Shall we find somewhere safe?
Night's coming. Maybe a shelter? I'll help you look.
suggest.carry: Your bag looks full! I've got room in mine.
Want me to carry some of that? I'll label it.
banter.reply: Really, {other}? I'd never thought of that.
greet.friend: {player}! I was hoping you'd come and talk!
Oh good, it's you. I've so much to tell you.
greet.cold: Yes? Is this about the... never mind.
recruit.taken: Oh, I'm travelling with {owner} at the moment! Maybe ask them if we can all go together?
I'd love to, but I promised {owner} I'd stick with them for now.
fail.protected: Not here, this is where people live! Let's find some proper wilderness.
I couldn't, not so close to everyone's homes. Somewhere wilder?
